title: # Build: crew-live (Urgent profile) Brett, Nov 3 2026 (voice).
asked: # Build: crew-live (Urgent profile) Brett, Nov 3 2026 (voice). Assigned agent: **Ping Paulie** (book on his card; AXF_AGENT=ping-paulie if supported). Register in Urgent (id `crew-live`) + banner entry. ## What Brett wants A console plugin 'Crew' that lists every agent (employee) currently working - if all six are working, six rows - with exactly what each is doing, live. Same look and behaviour as the other build grids (framework grid: collapsible rows, sort/search/filter, dense, phone first). ## Reuse first (find and build on these, don't duplicate) - Session browser plugin (`session-history`, PR #195): run store ingesting headless stream logs/reports, live feed, exact cost from usage, per-turn/per-command cost, live watch + kill. - headless-tabs (Terminal plugin): live cost counter per headless build from stream-json usage reconciled to total_cost_usd. - agent-swarm agent cards (names, stats, pay $7.50/h, history), Agent manager plugin, agent ID card artwork (AmberArt). - builds store (orch-live-sync) for build/step progress. ## Row (collapsed) Agent AVATAR + name, status dot (working / idle / stuck / waiting on approval), build + current step ('s3 of 7: ...') in plain English, model chip, LIVE timer (ticks every second since the job started, plus time on the current step), LIVE cost counter (updates as usage streams in), tokens, files touched count, PR link if any. ## Expanded row - Plain-English 'what I'm doing right now' (from the latest stream events, no LLM summarising - derive from tool calls/step text), step list with done/now/next. - Files being edited or created (created / modified / deleted badges, live). Each file expands to show the actual change: live diff of the worktree vs the build's base (git diff in /root/axf-builds/<name>/), syntax-highlighted, collapsible hunks. - Recent commands/tool calls with cost per command; link to open the run's Terminal tab (headless-tabs) and the Session browser entry. - Stop / kill (confirm) like the Session browser. - Idle agents shown in a collapsed 'Off the clock' section; totals bar: agents working, total cost today, total cost running now. ## Avatars everywhere The employee's avatar (from their agent card / ID card art; generated initials fallback) appears next to ANY of their tasks across the console: builds grids, Builds page views, orchestrator steps, What's New banner items, Session browser rows, UI Review items, PR rows, Terminal headless tab titles, group chat. One shared `AgentAvatar` framework component + `agent-avatar` asset/token so every plugin uses the same one; look up by AXF_AGENT/agent id on the build/run. ## Context menu Right-click (long-press on phone) any agent avatar or row, anywhere in the console: Open employee card (info, stats, pay, history, write-ups), Their current task, Their history / past runs, Open in Session browser, Open Terminal tab, Open group chat, Assign a job, Stop current job (confirm). Contributed as runtime context items so every plugin showing an avatar gets them. ## Rules - Zero tokens: the plugin is plain code reading logs/stores/git; no LLM calls (add a test that fails if it imports an LLM client). - Commands declared once -> REST + MCP + CLI (list working agents, agent detail, files, diff, stop) so Amber can read it by voice. - Tokens/assets only for styling; live via the existing live feed/websocket (no polling storms). - Tests, before/after screenshots 412/1280 px, UI Review item, report `_claude/builds/reports/crew-live.md`, THREADS, PR, steps through the store. Commits clean and professional. Watch live: Brett can watch the screen you are changing hot-render in the console. Whenever you start work on a screen or element, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "<what you are changing>"` (apps: console-web, axhub-web, amberx-droid, walkthrough-studio, demo, framework, console, axhub-android, voicevault). result.summary: Crew plugin (crew-live): live grid of every working agent with expanded steps, files + live diff, tool calls with cost, Stop; zero tokens; commands agents/agent/files/diff/stop on REST+MCP+CLI; framework AgentAvatar + agent directory + agent-avatar asset, agent context menu; avatars on orchestrator, Builds page, Terminal tabs, UI Review, What's New, group chat; capabilities axf.headless@1 + axf.swarm-roster@1.
